name: Appsmith Cloud
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Appsmith Cloud, compose an internal dashboard from a database and a fixed widget library. The hard boundary is connectors, enterprise permissions, workflows, support, and managed hosting, plus connectors, runtime reliability, and governance.
